rule_gaps: srcCat leaves 'Oljemaling'/'Akrylmaling'/'Akvarellmaling'/'Akvarellpapir' do not derive facets.type=Paint — every Old Holland and New Masters row (~20 here) carries a colour but no type, while Rembrandt rows get one only because 'Olje'/'Akvarell' is in the product NAME

the word 'Color'/'Colour' anywhere in a name derives type=Paint: it mis-typed Regia 4-ply Color (sock yarn) and Prym Non-sew Color Snaps (fasteners); 'pensel'/'akryl' in a brush breadcrumb does the same to brushes

Norwegian compound colour words are missing from the colour vocabulary: lyserosa, asurblå, gyldne, pastellrosa, dongeriblå, steingrå, rustrød, karminrød, solgul, postrød, mørkeblå, mørk gammelrosa (12 rows here)

the literal word 'hobby' in a product name or breadcrumb crumb promotes non-hobby goods into Hobby: 'Pippi Langstrømpe Hobby hest' (a toy), 'Bøker > Hobbybøker' (a book), and it is also why 'strikk'/'strikkede' rows (Casall/Gymstick resistance bands, a KappAhl sweater) land here
shop bucket labels are stored as brands: 'Oklassificerat' (Panduro), 'ANDRE MERKEVARER' (Obs/Obs Bygg), and plain shop names 'Lekia'/'Kids Dream Store' — these show up as filterable brand values

brand is left 'Unspecified' on roughly half the shard (nearly every Tegne.no row) although the name opens with it — Prym, PONY, Rembrandt, Old Holland, Museo, Marabu, Moleskine, Myboshi, Playcut, PanPastel, QoR; not reported per row, it is one extraction gap
notes: Genuinely a Hobby shard — the category itself is right for ~97% of rows; the real damage is structural, not topical. Five rows are outright in the wrong department (two resistance-band products, a sweater, a hobby horse, a book) and all five got here through 'hobby'/'strikk' word matches rather than a bad breadcrumb. The dominant defect is fragmentation: 29 paint/haberdashery colour and size families sit as separate top-level rows (New Masters 60 ml alone is 8 rows), plus one confirmed cross-shop duplicate of the same Rembrandt oil tube that keeps two prices from ever meeting. About half the rows have no image and many Tegne.no rows have a srcCat that is just the product name repeated, so the breadcrumb signal is absent exactly where brand and type extraction also fail.
